subject.why: The pink poodle skirt is immediately recognizable, complete with waist, flared circle shape, and poodle appliqué.

category.why: The skirt floats freely with a dynamic tilt against a saturated background with concentric rings, with no floor or surface.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The skirt is well-centered with comfortable margins on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant hot pink contrasts cleanly against the bright, saturated blue background.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and bold without distracting micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes with soft lighting and satin sheen, matching the reference cards perfectly.
